detailed_descriptions.en: Everyone’s favorite serial killer and trivia game show host, [REDACTED], is back and opening a summer camp full of trivia, murder, and outdoor enrichment! Grab your sleeping bag and get ready to survive Camp Mass Acres in a summer you’ll never forget. The rich visuals and immersive experience of Trivia Murder Party 3 Early Access require higher system requirements than our previous releases. Please review the system requirements prior to purchasing. Online Matchmaking For the first time in Jackbox history, Trivia Murder Party 3 will have online matchmaking to play with old friends and new! So grab some marshmallows, start a cozy campfire, and compete for your life in groups of up to eight players. Local Multiplayer [REDACTED] knows that online play isn’t every camper’s cup of tea, so local play modes with traditional Jackbox room codes will still be available in Trivia Murder Party 3 . Whether you’re playing with two campers or with a group of up to eight, you can hop into the same game from the couch, a bunkbed, or the trunk of a serial killer’s Jeep. No campers to play with? No worries! Join a group online and find your bunkmates. Use Your Phone As Your Controller Much like previous Jackbox Games titles, Trivia Murder Party 3 uses your phone or other web-enabled device as a controller to play along. Simply go to Jackbox.tv in your web browser and enter the 4-letter room code you see on the screen to join the game. More Trivia And New Minigames Trivia Murder Party 3 offers more trivia questions than Trivia Murder Party or Trivia Murder Party 2 ! [REDACTED] has also been cooking up some exciting new ways to punish players at his summer camp with new Killing Floor minigames, as well as revamped and refreshed minigames from previous entries in the series. Will you escape Camp Mass Acres or become another ghost story told around the campfire?
